turnRigContract.scalePolicy: Keep the 200x360 design canvas and current body proportions while adding turn angles. Do not resize, stretch, or rebalance the body before all angle parts are aligned.
turnRigContract.runtimePolicy: Do not add a planned angle to states until its fullbody fallback and split parts exist. Planned angles live here first so Pixi never loads missing PNGs.

turnRigContract.layerIdPolicy: Use the canonical slot id as the layer id for all new angles. Filenames may include direction suffixes, but Pixi layer ids should stay stable across angles.

rigNotes.hip: Use pelvis_vcut as the parent visual socket. Thigh sprites stay separate and rotate under it with overlap margins to hide seams.
rigNotes.spine: upper_abdomen and lower_abdomen should become separate parent containers before enabling waist bends.
rigNotes.face: Use mouth and eye parts as replaceable overlays on top of head or muzzle containers.
rigNotes.hands: Use open/fist hand sprites as pose swaps first; split fingers only if a future interaction needs finger-level control.
rigNotes.front30: front_left30/front_right30 use viewer-space layer ids and a 200x360 absolute rig. Arms are parented shoulder -> forearm -> hand so small raised-arm poses can reuse the same body without regenerating the sprite.
rigNotes.turnAngles20260706: front_left45/front_right45/back_left30/back_right30/back_3q now share the same canonical slots: head, chest_abdomen, pelvis, viewer-space arms and legs, tail segments, and simple face parts. Proportions remain on the 200x360 canvas; layer pivots are conservative root-level placements for later Pixi tuning.
rigNotes.front30MirrorRegen20260706: front_left30 was regenerated to better match the idle face shape; front_right30 is a direct horizontal mirror of it. Both states now use the 22 canonical slots including simple face parts.
rigNotes.backFull20260706: back_full adds a neutral complete rear view with the same 200x360 canvas and canonical split slots; invisible face slots are transparent placeholders.
rigNotes.sideSplit20260706: side_left and side_right are now split into the same 22 canonical slots from their existing 200x360 fullbody art. The side aliases front_left75/front_right75 document their role as near-side bridge frames; proportions were not resized.
rigNotes.walkForward8Frame20260706: Regenerated walk_forward from a single 8-pose sprite sheet so the feet move forward/back in perspective instead of just shifting sideways. Frames are cut to 200x360 with one shared scale factor.

walk_forward.notes: Eight-frame regenerated forward walk cycle. Unlike the earlier rig-offset draft, these frames are cut from a generated walk sprite sheet with forward/back foot depth, contact/down/passing/up poses, foot perspective scale, body compression/lift, opposite arm swing, and tail delay.
